### Del Monte Introduces Two New, Flavorful Canned Vegetable Varieties


October 19, 2026


*New Ranch Flavored Whole Kernel Corn, made in collaboration with Hidden Valley Ranch, and Zesty Italian Inspired Vinaigrette Cut Green Beans offer convenient, craveable ways to add bold flavor to everyday meals*


CORAL GABLES, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Del Monte Foods North America](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.delmonte.com%2F&esheet=54623560&newsitemid=20261019457908&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Foods+North+America&index=1&md5=2f117119edbb9660563838c18de293bc) , part of[Del Monte Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdelmontecorporation.com%2F&esheet=54623560&newsitemid=20261019457908&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Corporation&index=2&md5=4e3638a54b4fe2b431d5352766e23725) , is adding even more flavor to the center-of-store vegetable aisle with the launch of two new canned vegetable offerings: Del Monte® Ranch Flavored Whole Kernel Corn, created in collaboration with[Hidden Valley™ Ranch](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hiddenvalley.com%2F&esheet=54623560&newsitemid=20261019457908&lan=en-US&anchor=Hidden+Valley%26%238482%3B+Ranch&index=3&md5=34ab6d089d471e99d9ca91b5cb4de982) , and Del Monte® Zesty Italian Inspired Vinaigrette Cut Green Beans. The new products expand Del Monte’s portfolio of bold-flavored canned vegetables, developed to meet growing demand for convenient, easy-to-prepare foods that deliver both flavor and value. As more consumers cook and eat at home, especially younger households seeking familiar tastes with a unique twist, Del Monte is making it easier to turn everyday vegetables into craveable sides, snacks and recipe starters.


Del Monte Introduces Two New, Flavorful Canned Vegetable Varieties


“Today's families are looking for meal solutions that fit the realities of modern life, and we’re proud to help make mealtime easier and more enjoyable every day,” comments Chris Faller, Del Monte Corporation, VP of Marketing, Foods Division. “Our latest offerings continue to challenge outdated perceptions of canned vegetables as a new generation of consumers prioritize taste and find convenient, affordable and reliable ways to put delicious food on the table.”


**Making Way for Bold Taste** Del Monte® Ranch Flavored Whole Kernel Corn brings together two beloved brands that lead their respective categories in one flavorful, new product. Developed with Hidden Valley Ranch, known for delicious, versatile condiments and seasoning, the new canned corn combines Del Monte’s quality vegetables with the tangy, herby flavor of ranch. The launch marks the first product in an ongoing collaboration between Del Monte and Hidden Valley Ranch, with additional flavor-forward innovation planned for next year.


Del Monte® Zesty Italian Inspired Vinaigrette Cut Green Beans offer a tangy, spicy flavor inspired by one of America’s favorite dressing profiles. The new variety gives consumers an easy way to add a bright, savory kick to side dishes, bowls, casseroles, sheet-pan meals and more.


“Ranch is one of the most beloved flavors in America, while Italian inspired flavors continue to be a familiar favorite for consumers,” adds Faller. “With our latest bold-flavored vegetable offerings, we’re making it easier for households to bring craveable flavor to everyday vegetables. Our collaboration with Hidden Valley Ranch is one of the ways Del Monte is reimagining the canned vegetable aisle with convenient options that deliver on both quality and taste.”


Del Monte is the first brand to bring these two fan-favorite flavors to the center-of-the-store vegetable category, at a time when Gen Z and Millennial households are seeking convenient foods that deliver both flavor and value. Both new products are made with U.S.-grown vegetables, picked at the peak of freshness and crafted with non-GMO ingredients*. They can be enjoyed on their own as a simple side dish or incorporated into recipes for an easy flavor boost the whole family can enjoy.


Del Monte® Ranch Flavored Whole Kernel Corn and Del Monte® Zesty Italian Inspired Vinaigrette Cut Green Beans are now available on shelves across the U.S. at Giant Eagle, Price Chopper, Tops, Food Lion, Giant Food, Hannaford, Wakefern, Meijer, Schnucks, Hyvee, Price Chopper, Tops, Fareway, AWG, Niemann Foods, Spartan Nash and Amazon, and will be available at Kroger in early November. To learn more about the Del Monte® brand and its[latest products](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.delmonte.com%2Fproducts&esheet=54623560&newsitemid=20261019457908&lan=en-US&anchor=latest+products&index=4&md5=204fbb693108a2f394335da3e0f0d994) , visit[www.delmonte.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.delmonte.com&esheet=54623560&newsitemid=20261019457908&lan=en-US&anchor=www.delmonte.com&index=5&md5=f034370899d27da0296e8d20aec8101f) .


*Green Beans are a NON-GMO vegetable.

**About Del Monte Corporation**[Del Monte Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdelmontecorporation.com%2F&esheet=54623560&newsitemid=20261019457908&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Corporation&index=10&md5=e96138b73d369da71ec1bde4af2d3c64) (NYSE: DMC) is one of the world's leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable food products, with products sold in more than 90 countries worldwide. As the global owner of the Del Monte® brand, subject to certain existing licensing arrangements, the company operates across fresh produce, fresh-cut fruit and vegetables, refrigerated foods and shelf-stable categories, serving consumers around the world with a portfolio built on quality, innovation and trust.


Formerly Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc., the company changed its corporate name to Del Monte Corporation in June 2026, reflecting its expanded role as steward of one of the world's most recognized food brands and its commitment to unlocking new opportunities for growth, innovation and global brand expansion.


The Del Monte® brand has been a symbol of quality, freshness and reliability for more than 135 years and is the No. 1 canned vegetable brand in the United States, according to Circana2. Del Monte Corporation is not affiliated with certain other Del Monte companies around the world, including Del Monte Asia Pte. Ltd. The company is the first global marketer of fruits and vegetables to commit to the Science Based Targets initiative and has been recognized as one of America's Most Trusted Companies by Newsweek and named a Humankind 100 Company by Humankind Investments.


Del Monte Corporation is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol DMC.
